outcome_detail: Filed July 2025 in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Ohio; active as of 2026 alongside the related March 2025 case, with proceedings that had been paused during Edwards' criminal appeals now moving forward. No settlement or judgment reported.
criminal_detail: Michael Edwards Jr. was convicted in September 2024 on charges including rape, sexual battery, gross sexual imposition, extortion and theft in office involving six victims, and sentenced to 34 to 39 years in prison; his convictions and sentence were upheld on appeal and the Ohio Supreme Court declined review.
description: A fourth woman, a 33-year-old Niles resident, filed a lawsuit in July 2025 in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Ohio against former Warren police officer Michael Edwards Jr., Police Chief Erik Merkel, and the City of Warren. According to the complaint, the woman met Edwards in February 2023 when he responded to a 911 call about a friend's drug overdose, and he allegedly continued contacting her afterward, culminating in a sexual assault in fall 2023 while she was heavily intoxicated. The suit alleges a widespread practice of on-duty Warren officers committing sexual assaults, sexual coercion and sexual extortion against vulnerable women, and claims Merkel and the city failed to investigate complaints or curb Edwards' behavior. The plaintiff seeks compensatory damages, punitive damages, and attorney fees, and has demanded a jury trial. Edwards was convicted in 2024 of rape and related charges and is serving a 34-to-39-year sentence.
notes: Companion records: rec-33 (three-plaintiff suit filed March 2025) and rec-33c ($1 million suit filed February 2026) arise from the same scandal.
